notes.betting_rule: Results settled at 90 min + injury time. All draw stats use draw_after_90 only, never the 1/X/2 result.
notes.game_no_continuous: Re-based chronologically across 2014 -> 2018 -> 2022 (1-64 = 2014, 65-128 = 2018, 129-192 = 2022, 193-194 = first 2026 games). Will extend as more World Cups are added.
notes.verification: Every game's score was recomputed from its goals (normal-time only) and matched the recorded score. 194/194 reconciled, 0 contradictions (incl. first 2 live 2026 games). Goal totals match official figures: 2014=171, 2018=169, 2022=172.
notes.rankings: Each world_cup carries its pre-tournament FIFA ranking (ranking_snapshot date) as teams[]: fifa_rank (official world position) + fifa_points. Participant rank (1..N) is DERIVED by sorting teams by fifa_rank, not stored. Source: Dato-Futbol/fifa-ranking historical CSV (official FIFA). World rank derived by ordering all teams that date by points. Snapshots = last official edition before each opener: 2014-06-05, 2018-06-07, 2022-10-06. Note: 2018 Denmark & England tied on 1051 pts (ranks 12/13 by sort order, arbitrary between them). 2014/2018 use FIFA's old integer-point system; 2022 the newer decimal system.
notes.odds: Fenced, raw only (implied probs derived not stored), outside verification, does NOT move data_version. One LATEST line per game (no snapshot history). On refresh: upcoming games overwritten with the new line; PLAYED games are FROZEN (their pre-kickoff line is retained and never overwritten/dropped, even though the bookmaker removes them from later scrapes). Freeze marker = game_no_in_wc is set (null = upcoming). Source names mapped Swedish->ASCII.
